ring_transfer_metrics.measurement_note: In-horizon observed application ACK payload per frame, including partial chunks. Excludes TCP overhead and retransmissions; not a wire-utilization measurement.
ring_transfer_metrics.partial_metric_note: Planned ring connectivity. Strict partial bytes have both frame launch and observed application ACK inside the same contiguous partial-connectivity interval; crossing bytes separate. ACK observation is not actual wire time. No retransmission bytes counted.

transport_exposure_note: Completed collective interval overlap on detected NCCL ring/ACK edges; null when topology is unverified; risk not failure.
timeout_count_note: Lower bound: maximum of event-log timeout count and distinct NCCL watchdog rank/sequence reports; avoids counting duplicated logs twice.
useful_contact_utilization_note: Requires observed attributable on-wire bytes and per-link applied capacity; E2 logical collective sizes are not on-wire volume.
observed_tcp_bytes_note: No validated per-flow TCP aggregation in this summary; see E2 socket monitoring

per_rank_nic_counters.note: node-global NIC counters; not attributable to training process

communication_blocked_s_note: E2 ready->complete is NOT pure communication idle; E3 deferral is separately recorded
interruption_note: Exposed to scheduled outage is a timestamp overlap risk, NOT a confirmed failed collective.
recovery_note: Post-outage first completed rank-level communication; missing observations are censored
scheduler_latency_note: Local TX waits are logged; no per-step central grant or filesystem rendezvous
flower_caveat: Flower server and rank0 client co-located; local traffic bypasses shaped link
